Reset is known at the first data and Q corruption; later reset observations are retained separately.
Notifier and xcr_0 initially X in both variants; notifier never changes. An initial static X is distinct from first newly observed X.

Candidate roots _107542_/_107556_ are o21ai gates with shared input _047302_. Their input waveforms are absent, so shared-control versus other upstream-data origin is unresolved.

not_proved: Which o21ai input first became unknown
That _047302_ is the cause rather than a different input
Four-state equivalence or a safe RTL/model repair

limitations: The concrete upstream cause remains unknown until actual pinned cloud cone inputs are observed.

Observation order is scheduler execution order, not a simulator delta index; no-change callbacks are suppressed.

document.scope: Exact dependency/own source hashes; source review; 94 focused tests; independent five actual native-model controls including static-X unmasking and coalesced zero-delay pulse. Original 3M-cycle chip boot and source-bound cone mapping required in GitHub; not inferred from tiny controls.

review_findings: Exact netlist/model hashes and prior 441-state alias witness gate source-bound D roots and unique depth-two upstream conductor ownership before the real cloud compile.
Original firmware/ROM/loader, vendor SRAM models, FUNCTIONAL native library mode, reset, and the full 3000000-cycle bound are preserved by frozen preparation and post-compile pins.
Observer reads scalar native pins and internal nets only; no DUT assignment, force, deposit, release, or implicit replacement model. Baseline bench is regenerated and compared before run.
INIT separately records pre-existing X/Z; EV requires a changed value and complete prior-state chain; the parser checks every 161-cycle sample against observed history.
Both startup and final uploads use if-always, include hidden source files, fail on missing artifacts, and preserve a failed boot without treating diagnostic workflow success as acceptance.
Native child credentials are stripped and original clock/reset timing is preserved; actual five native cases reproduce their uninstrumented D/Q trajectories.
limitations: Observed callback order is not a simulator delta index. A scalar pulse which returns to its prior value before its callback can be coalesced; this is explicitly tested and must not be described as a lossless glitch trace.
Cone depth/cell/signal/event bounds are diagnostic observation limits only. Aliased or non-native sources remain explicit frontiers, not assumed cutpoints.

This review reparses and hashes the saved five exact native cases and independently runs the 94 focused tests (including their small native controls). It does not execute the full-chip cloud cone binding or the 3M-cycle boot.
No four-state boot acceptance, functional repair, timing closure, or manufacturing approval is implied.

conclusions.observed: At cycle 1569430, candidate D/delayed_D for NPU state bits 0 and 3 first become unknown after a clean clock rise. Q/IQ remain known until the next clean rise at 1569431. First newly unknown clock and reset occur later, at 1569434 and 1569505. Notifier and xcr_0 are initially unknown in both variants; initial static unknowns are not first-new-transition evidence.
conclusions.source_binding: Candidate direct D drivers _107542_ and _107556_ are pinned sg13g2_o21ai_1 cells sharing _047302_. Their existing capture lacks input waveforms, so the common conductor is a diagnostic target, not an established cause.
conclusions.hypothesis: An upstream combinational unknown is sampled by the native state DFF. Whether a new unknown arrives or a previously latent unknown becomes unmasked remains unresolved.
conclusions.next_experiment: A separate read-only original/candidate observer traces the exact root inputs/outputs, shared-control producer and bounded source-proven predecessor cone, preserving the original three-million-cycle test, firmware, reset, clocks, RTL and native cell models.

diagnostic_contract.conductor_identity: Exact expression.strip() matching preserves escaped identifier terminators. Unmatched aliases remain explicit frontiers, never inferred connections.
diagnostic_contract.observation_semantics: Recorded callback order is not a simulator delta index or lossless glitch trace. Coalesced callbacks whose observed final value is unchanged are suppressed, and the behavior is exercised by a real pulse control.
